preconditions.description: The value of n is at least 1 and at most 100.
The value of m is at least 1 and at most 100.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All x-coordinates are within the range from 0 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= y <= m for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All y-coordinates are within the range from 0 to m.

postconditions.expression: all(x + y > 0 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All points have positive sum of coordinates.
The distance between any two points is not an integer.
